title: Document the optional session-list browser geometry check for CSS changes
outcome: Session-row CSS authors can find the optional real-browser geometry guard and know when to run it, without adding a browser prerequisite to the full gate.
acceptance: docs/test.md names scripts/check-session-list-layout.mjs, its repository-root command with an explicit absolute Chrome/Chromium executable, and session-row CSS changes as the occasion to run it.
The guidance distinguishes the reduced actual-CSS markup fixture from actual-App behavior coverage and does not add a mandatory browser prerequisite to the maintained full gate.
